# Autopilot decision log — <fill: project>

> Written by `/autopilot` **as it runs**, never at the end. Every decision taken on the human's behalf is one
> row. This is the price of the green light: a run that made forty decisions and recorded none of them cannot
> be reviewed, only re-done.
>
> **Rule** is which clause of the playbook's Step 3 was used:
> `RECOMMENDED` — an option was marked recommended and was taken ·
> `ASSUMED` — options existed, none recommended, the most reversible was taken ·
> `BRIEF` — the answer was already in the brief or the spec, and is quoted ·
> `STOPPED` — nothing applied, so the run stopped and asked.
